title: Exact Bloch-Sphere Surrogates, Heisenberg R_zz Entangler Leakage, and Token-Mixing Barriers for Multi-Head Quantum Neural Networks inside Large Language Models
abstract: Amoussou et al. (arXiv:2611.15250, Nov 2026) showed that a 145,281-parameter multi-head QNN (D = 2048, k = 32 heads, n_q = 8 qubits, L = 4 layers) can replace up to eight contiguous transformer blocks in Qwen3-30B-A3B and run on a 156-qubit IBM Heron processor, while leaving three empirical anomalies unexplained: collapse of the no-circuit mixer control (alpha -> 0.004) on sensitive Layer 1, superior perplexity of entangler-off and frozen-angle controls over trained entangled circuits, and failure of scattered replacements to compose on long-range tasks (LAMBADA). We resolve all three anomalies algebraically with 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems and 16 exact Q[i] certificates. First, entangler-off heads factorize into n_q decoupled SO(3) Bloch evolutions, giving an exact O(n_q L) classical surrogate reproducing all 1- and 2-qubit Pauli expectations with 64/3x state compression at n_q = 8. Second, we prove strict odd-parity L^2 orthogonality of M_2 tanh(M_1 x) against all even/bias components, and derive exact Heisenberg-picture R_zz leakage laws showing that interior 1-qubit {X,Y}_q leak sin^2(g_{q-1})sin^2(g_q), mixed {X,Y}Z leak sin^2(g_{q-1})cos^2(g_q), and interior transverse 2-qubit {X,Y}_q{X,Y}_{q+1} leak 1 - cos^2(g_{q-1})cos^2(g_{q+1}) into the 99.85% unmeasured weight >= 3 Pauli space (75% single-layer loss at gamma = pi/4, 100% extinction at pi/2, and 28/87 = 32.2% mean loss at n_q = 8). Third, we prove the exact conditional-variance token-mixing barrier E[Var(F_t(X) | x_t)] for any position-wise replacement and prove classical readout parameter dominance >= 2/3 whenever d_h >= 14 (131,072/145,281 = 90.22% in Qwen3-30B).
